literal: by wealth / will happen / everything / thinking that / not giving / hoarding / from delusion / results / unexcellent / birth
translation: From the delusion of hoarding wealth without giving, thinking that everything is achieved through it, results a wretched birth.
modern: பொருளால் எல்லாம் நடக்கும் என்று நினைத்து, யாருக்கும் எதையும் கொடுக்காமல் சேர்த்து வைக்கும் மயக்கத்தால், ஒருவனுக்குச் சிறப்பற்ற பிறவி உண்டாகும்.
explanation: The couplet warns against the obsessive accumulation of wealth. It describes a person who believes that money can accomplish absolutely everything, leading them to hoard it without giving anything to others. This mindset is termed a 'delusion' (மருள்). The consequence of such a deluded, miserly life is an 'inglorious birth' (மாணாப் பிறப்பு), meaning a wretched and miserable existence.
